records.text: North Korean TV didn't carry any live coverage of New Year's Eve in Pyongyang. As it did last year, it ended 2025 with a photo compilation of Kim Jong Un's work and a new year message. records.text: We noticed something interesting about North Korea's new warships. State media video has been limited and in all the satellite images we have, they are moored or being moved by tugs. records.text: For the first time, North Korean state TV has shown its soldiers battling inside Ukraine. This came the same day it televised a ceremony where Kim Jong Un honored over 100 soldiers who were killed in the fighting.

records.text: Kim Jong Un visited his new destroyer (the one that didn't fall over) in Nampho on Monday. Unfortunately, North Korean state media blurred out the good bits. We still haven't seen this ship move away from the dock since it was pushed there by tug shortly after launch in late April.
